text_block_list.text:
When I arrived at the shrine to pray
together with Silence Suzuka—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Mmmm!
I sense an aura of bad luck coming from Suzuka-san!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh, Fukukitaru.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: No, this was meant to be!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It's a divine sign telling me to pray to the gods
to boost Suzuka-san's luck!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ehh...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: And so, I shall demonstrate an example, so keep your eyes peeled and behold—!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hannyaka~! Funnyaka~!
Kashikomi, kashikomi, honjamage~!
Luck, go up~~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Come on, come on, come on!
You too, Suzuka-san—!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: M-Me too...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Of cooouuuurse it is!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I-It's a nice thought, but I think I'll pass.
I'll just stick to having mine normal, okay...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Here we go! Hannyaka~!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh... What...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hannyaka~~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: H-Hannyaka~...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Funnyaka~!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Funnyaka~...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, I can really feel the blessing!
I feel like I'm in tip-top shape now!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: To think it's actually effective...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Nfufu~♪ Good things come to those who believe!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Hannyaka~, funnyaka~...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Huh... No way, really...?
I'm genuinely feeling so much better—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Oh, did you say something just now~?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: N-No, it's nothing...!

Perhaps thanks to the divine blessing from the shrine,
Silence Suzuka displayed fantastic running form in the practice that followed.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh, the divine blessings are kicking in...
How does it feel, Suzuka-san!?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...
I don't really feel like my condition's improved much...
(Meoooow...)
(Caw, caw! Caw, caw!)

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Gyaaaaaah, an omen ensemble!
A whole flock of black cats and crows came swarming in!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder if someone's been feeding them?
Whether it was due to the bad omen or not, Silence Suzuka remained out of sorts throughout the rest of practice.
